a_realclass_act2: Dorian "Ash" Act was a butcher's boy in Oakmere until the posters went up. He came to N-F6 with a pocket Bible with a hole in it, and within a day the whole squad knew that he draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters.
Dorian "Ash" Act spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Dorian "Ash" Act's hands still remember being a butcher's boy's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Jakub Dersteven (Hegemony) watched Dorian "Ash" Act (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Ossuary Wood, and held fire until both were gone.
Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony lost a harmonica in no man's land at the Chalk Pits. Dorian "Ash" Act of the Concord found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it.

Dorian "Ash" Act was on watch at N-F6 when the night raid hit. The men found Dorian "Ash" Act at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Valentin "Spark" Waxy of the Hegemony (@waxy4422).
Bram "Mole" Act came to the front because his cousin Dorian "Ash" Act never came home. He carries a pocket Bible with a hole in it.
Across from N-F6, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Bram "Mole" Act saw it. Marek "Saint" Aoidragon was badly wounded.
ajango117: On Day 10 Karel "Mud" Ajango took a post at V-F12 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He collects shell fuses, and the men liked him for it.

Karel "Mud" Ajango checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more. After the loss of Grey Mill, Karel "Mud" Ajango helped stack spare sandbags at V-F12. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
The old Private did not come back from the wire. Karel "Mud" Ajango wears his stripes now: Lance Corporal.
On sentry duty Karel "Mud" Ajango watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.

Karel "Mud" Ajango felt a hard tug at his hip at V-F12. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Yann Ethan of the Hegemony (@dill_ethan).

The medic looked at Karel "Mud" Ajango's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to V-F12. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Orders came through: Karel "Mud" Ajango is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a pressed cornflower.

Karel "Mud" Ajango jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Jonas Bourque. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@jb_bourque) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Karel "Mud" Ajango hit Casimir Singh with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@aishwarya.singh_05) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Karel "Mud" Ajango snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Karel "Mud" Ajango free. A short letter reached Karel "Mud" Ajango: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Karel "Mud" Ajango read the part about the dog twice.

Karel "Mud" Ajango is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. A letter from home reached Karel "Mud" Ajango before dusk. Karel "Mud" Ajango read it twice and slept a little easier.
arno.smolders: By the time Karel Smolders reached T-S12, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel Smolders kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch wrote a song about Saint-Ash crossroads. Karel Smolders wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Smolders. Karel Smolders read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Karel Smolders wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Karel Smolders laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Smolders. Karel Smolders read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Karel Smolders (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at the Sunken Road. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Yann Cnfilip: 'Fair trade.' Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Smolders. Karel Smolders read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Karel Smolders let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Albin Edwardss was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Smolders. Karel Smolders read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Karel Smolders and Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
Karel Smolders fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch and Karel Smolders share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
coketez: Benedikt Coketez walked into T-F20 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F20 with the rations. Benedikt Coketez ate while listening to the revised orders.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Benedikt Coketez asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Benedikt Coketez watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Benedikt Coketez had Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony in the sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Roland "Ash" Hud was lighting a pipe. Benedikt Coketez let the match burn all the way down.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Benedikt Coketez. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
Benedikt Coketez snores. Ulrich Mercenary does not. Ulrich now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
A recruit asked Benedikt Coketez how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Benedikt Coketez and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen.
The recruit wrote a first short letter without Benedikt Coketez's help. He was allowed to check the envelope, but not the contents.
collectr_world: Karel "Ash" World arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a letter he never sent and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Karel "Ash" World let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Karel "Ash" World found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: an old man with a dog, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
A man asked Karel "Ash" World to describe Old Harrow without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.

Karel "Ash" World keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a letter he never sent. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Karel "Ash" World watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Karel "Ash" World changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Machine-gun fire swept R-F6. Karel "Ash" World took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck).
Karel "Ash" World died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
Matthias World came to the front because his uncle Karel "Ash" World never came home. He carries a letter he never sent.
A single shot from across the wire hit Matthias World in the thigh at R-F6. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck).

Matthias World has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Matthias World wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Matthias World healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Matthias World answered to number 186. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Matthias World kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Matthias World felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F6. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte).
Matthias World walked back up the communication trench to R-F6, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Matthias World came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire.
Matthias World drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.

At R-F6 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Matthias World turned around and took a shovel blow. Clement "Spark" Cbour of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Clement "Spark" Cbour of the Hegemony (@cbour57_).
Matthias World was hit in the foot through his boot at R-F6. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Florian Danielmcmena of the Hegemony (@danielmcmenamy).
connor.3182: Nobody asked Nils Connor why he came. Nobody in S-R15 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Nils Connor heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Nils Connor felt a hard tug at his hip at S-R15. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Ivo "Saint" Klaymore of the Hegemony (@klaymore817). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Nils Connor answered to number 962. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-R15. Nils Connor has learned to walk bent double.
Three days with a bandage, and Nils Connor is back at S-R15. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
The blast lifted Nils Connor off his feet at S-R15. He came round with a bloody nose and an empty rifle and went back to work.
The medic cut the last bandage off Nils Connor's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-R15 the same hour.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Nils Connor lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
A bullet found Nils Connor at S-R15, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Ivo "Saint" Klaymore of the Hegemony (@klaymore817).

Nils Connor tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back. Nils Connor reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up.
cris_infante6: Day 11. The corporal put Dietrich Infante beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Dietrich Infante stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

At Blackwater Canal, Dietrich Infante of the Concord and Bastian Bloom of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Infante. Dietrich Infante read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dietrich Infante found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Infante. Dietrich Infante read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dietrich Infante went out with the wiring party at V-F15. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Infante. Dietrich Infante read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Dietrich Infante read a theatre review while peeling supper.

Dietrich Infante went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Hegemony trench a man turned around too late. Gustav Simonb did not get up again. (@simonb112727) Dietrich Infante made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Dietrich Infante crawled the last yards. Dietrich Infante read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Dietrich Infante in the open at V-F15. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory of the Hegemony (@wesley.gregory.00). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Dietrich Infante fell at V-F15 and never moved again. Shot by Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory of the Hegemony (@wesley.gregory.00).

Lucien Infante joined V-F15 under the shadow of Dietrich Infante's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Lucien's transfer to the role of stretcher bearer was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
daniel.gabor.77964: Albin Gabor came from Tannenfeld, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In N-F9, Albin Gabor listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A supply man offered Albin Gabor a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Albin Gabor coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a waltz with a scratched introduction, but something knocks once every revolution.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Albin Gabor tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through a waltz with a scratched introduction, spoiling the best part.
Albin Gabor passed the gramophone to the next section with a note about the screw. By evening, a waltz with a scratched introduction could be heard faintly through the wall.

Albin Gabor was on the dawn watch at N-F9 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Albin Gabor was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Yann Meter of the Hegemony (@xen0meter).
Albin Gabor sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow.
daniel_abraham_uk: Ivo Abraham told the sergeant he was a fisherman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Ivo Abraham went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Ivo Abraham looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A bullet went through Ivo Abraham's sleeve at P-F12 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Norbert Cos of the Hegemony (@panco_cos).
The medic looked at Ivo Abraham's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to P-F12. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Ivo Abraham ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.

A bullet hit Ivo Abraham in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at P-F12. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Lucien "Parson" Tec of the Hegemony (@k1lean.tec).
There were too few medics and too many wounded. Ivo Abraham waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it.
Ivo Abraham waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Ivo Abraham no longer needed it.
The House of Abraham sent another. Bram "Doc" Abraham, father of Ivo Abraham, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
fuadhekal: After 8 days of war, R-S14 had a place for everything. On Day 8, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Dorian Fuadhekal.

Dorian Fuadhekal studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked R-S14 in the dark to learn it by heart. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Fuadhekal. Dorian Fuadhekal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Dorian Fuadhekal's ear at R-S14 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Dietrich Rankine of the Hegemony (@rankine_459.67). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Dorian Fuadhekal watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Fuadhekal. Dorian Fuadhekal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dorian Fuadhekal returned to R-S14 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Fuadhekal. Dorian Fuadhekal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dorian Fuadhekal answered to number 522. Grey Mill is lost. Dorian Fuadhekal heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A report called the trench satisfactory. Dorian Fuadhekal invited the author to spend a night in it before signing. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Fuadhekal. Dorian Fuadhekal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dorian Fuadhekal passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Fuadhekal. Dorian Fuadhekal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dorian Fuadhekal checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Fuadhekal. Dorian Fuadhekal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dorian Fuadhekal raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-S14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Zeno Cdub of the Hegemony (@cdub_b1). Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Fuadhekal. Dorian Fuadhekal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medics cleaned Dorian Fuadhekal's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-S14. Dorian Fuadhekal read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
A bullet clipped Dorian Fuadhekal's helmet at R-S14 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob of the Hegemony (@bobthesnob391).
gndr_euphoria: Tobias Euphoria reached R-S4 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. Tobias Euphoria asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a runner. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Tobias Euphoria's bunk. He has named it Little Sergeant. A letter from home reached Tobias Euphoria before dusk. Tobias Euphoria read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Euphoria ran a message through the communication trench under shellfire. The message said: 'Hold.' A letter from home reached Tobias Euphoria before dusk. Tobias Euphoria read it twice and slept a little easier.

The raid was quick, the way back was not. Tobias Euphoria snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Tobias Euphoria free. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Euphoria watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. A letter from home reached Tobias Euphoria before dusk. Tobias Euphoria read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Euphoria's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. A letter from home reached Tobias Euphoria before dusk. Tobias Euphoria read it twice and slept a little easier. Tobias Euphoria got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 491. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Tobias Euphoria folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Little Sergeant the rat now waits for Tobias Euphoria at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations. A letter from home reached Tobias Euphoria before dusk. Tobias Euphoria read it twice and slept a little easier.

Little Sergeant ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Tobias Euphoria followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Little Sergeant his life. A letter from home reached Tobias Euphoria before dusk. Tobias Euphoria read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet grazed Tobias Euphoria's ribs at R-S4. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. A letter from home reached Tobias Euphoria before dusk. Tobias Euphoria read it twice and slept a little easier.

Three days with a bandage, and Tobias Euphoria is back at R-S4. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. A letter from home reached Tobias Euphoria before dusk. Tobias Euphoria read it twice and slept a little easier. Tobias Euphoria's transfer to the role of sapper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Tobias Euphoria landed next to Yann "Rabbit" Franz in the Concord trench. Only Tobias Euphoria climbed back out. (@frankly_franz) Tobias Euphoria crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Quentin Adams reached for a rifle. Tobias Euphoria was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@_smokey_adams_) The letter for Tobias Euphoria ended with 'come home soon'. Tobias Euphoria read the last line more than the rest.

A round went through Tobias Euphoria's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Felix Bubik of the Concord (@bubik_233). A letter reached Tobias Euphoria with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Tobias Euphoria tried to as well.
historygeek1862: In Varenne, Bastian Historygeek was a postman. In R-C16, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a postman again.

The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Bastian Historygeek looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. A letter from home reached Bastian Historygeek before dusk. Bastian Historygeek read it twice and slept a little easier.

The corporal found out Bastian Historygeek used to be a postman. Bastian Historygeek has been doing two jobs ever since. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Bastian Historygeek is number 696. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Bastian Historygeek helped stack spare sandbags at R-C16. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Bastian Historygeek polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
Bastian Historygeek of the Concord and Bastian Enjoyer of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near the Ossuary Wood all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Bastian Historygeek and Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.

Bastian Historygeek felt a hard tug at his hip at R-C16. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Silas Cosmicloopy of the Hegemony (@cosmicloopy).
The medic cut the last bandage off Bastian Historygeek's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-C16 the same hour.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of R-C16. When Bastian Historygeek challenged it, there was nobody there.
invisible_polish_box: Teodor "Spark" Box reached R-R8 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Teodor "Spark" Box shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Teodor "Spark" Box and Gustav Dillonl made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. Victory at Grey Mill. Teodor "Spark" Box let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Ulrich "Bones" Swan kept watch so that Teodor "Spark" Box could sleep. Then Spark kept watch so that Bones could. Neither slept.
Teodor "Spark" Box found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Teodor "Spark" Box was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-R8. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that.

Teodor "Spark" Box was hit through the stomach at R-R8. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson of the Concord (@keaganwilson085). Teodor "Spark" Box was killed outright at R-R8, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson of the Concord (@keaganwilson085).
Zeno Box took the same post at R-R8 where Teodor "Spark" Box stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Zeno Box left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.

A bullet went through Zeno Box's upper arm at R-R8 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Yann Liamroberts of the Concord (@liamroberts141). A single shot at R-R8. Zeno Box sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Yann Liamroberts of the Concord (@liamroberts141).
The House of Box sent another. Dorian "Mud" Box, older brother of Zeno Box, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
jacksondeehring: Isidor Jacksondeehr arrived on Day 5 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Isidor Jacksondeehr tipped water from a boot and a small beetle climbed out. At least one passenger had enjoyed the crossing. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Isidor Jacksondeehr watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Isidor Jacksondeehr tried to remember the price of a loaf in Port Abel. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Isidor Jacksondeehr closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Isidor Jacksondeehr saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-F21 and fired once. Rafael Broadshoulde was grazed.
A bullet clipped Isidor Jacksondeehr's helmet at S-F21 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Leopold Staryfins of the Hegemony (@staryfins).

Isidor Jacksondeehr walked back up the communication trench to S-F21, slower than before, but on his own feet. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Isidor Jacksondeehr watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Isidor Jacksondeehr borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Matthias "Brick" Fish was badly wounded. Isidor Jacksondeehr got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 331. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Isidor Jacksondeehr stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Isidor Jacksondeehr heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
Isidor Jacksondeehr rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
Isidor Jacksondeehr offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
Isidor Jacksondeehr reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F21 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Severin "Crow" Boy of the Hegemony (@st0nk_boy).
A bullet found Isidor Jacksondeehr at S-F21, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael of the Hegemony (@elbert_nathanael).
Isidor Jacksondeehr lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
lud0_retarded: Day 6: Zeno Retarded reached S-S6 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Zeno Retarded lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.

Zeno Retarded and Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. A letter from home found Zeno Retarded before the night shift. Zeno Retarded folded it small and kept it close.
Zeno Retarded of the Hegemony and Rafael Davidsonmars of the Concord watched a broken branch near the Brickworks all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Zeno Retarded during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A bullet grazed Zeno Retarded's ribs at S-S6. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks of the Concord (@csllgaks). A letter from home found Zeno Retarded before the night shift. Zeno Retarded folded it small and kept it close. Zeno Retarded got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 439. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Zeno Retarded folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
The wound on Zeno Retarded's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Zeno Retarded cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Zeno Retarded pulled Jakub Faulerhund out of a flooded shell hole at Lantern Hill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Zeno Retarded spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Zeno Retarded landed next to Otto Hop in the Concord trench. Only Zeno Retarded climbed back out. (@its.hop_) In the dark of the Concord trench Zeno Retarded hit Yann Vee with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@ask._.vee) Zeno Retarded came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.

Zeno Retarded returned to S-S6 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. The letter for Zeno Retarded was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Zeno Retarded liked the crossed-out parts best.
pasoslargos100: Karel Pasoslargos took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

A bullet hit Karel Pasoslargos's belt buckle at Q-F8 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Roland Eugeneous of the Concord (@eugeneous911). News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Karel Pasoslargos during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Karel Pasoslargos walked back up the communication trench to Q-F8, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Karel Pasoslargos did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Karel Pasoslargos fired back. Konrad Manthatsment was badly wounded.
Otto Thorkill of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at Lantern Hill. Karel Pasoslargos of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.

A bullet hit Karel Pasoslargos in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at Q-F8. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Karel Mstk of the Concord (@sam_mstk13).

There were too few medics and too many wounded. Karel Pasoslargos waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it. Karel Pasoslargos was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door.
Karel Pasoslargos opened his eyes today and asked for water. At Q-F8 they cheered when the news came up the line.
realpayton123: Dietrich Realpayton left a sweetheart who has stopped writing behind in Marrow Fen and came up the line with a letter he never sent. The men noticed at once that he whistles the same four notes over and over. Orders came through: Dietrich Realpayton is a chaplain now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a letter he never sent.

Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich Realpayton watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper. A letter from home reached Dietrich Realpayton before dusk. Dietrich Realpayton read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dietrich Realpayton kept Roland "Whistle" Itswangz awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Dietrich could have walked there blind. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Dietrich Realpayton read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet went through Dietrich Realpayton's upper arm at T-F11 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Gustav Bonie of the Hegemony (@mr_bonie3).
Someone moved Dietrich Realpayton's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
Dietrich Realpayton never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Bastian "Shadow" Fish (Hegemony) and Dietrich Realpayton (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Brickworks. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
Dietrich Realpayton came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire.
Dietrich Realpayton found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
s.123409875612: Lucien S was a blacksmith in Varenne until the posters went up. He came to U-F8 with a tin whistle, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Lucien S during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A bullet hit Lucien S in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at U-F8. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Tobias Metal of the Concord (@metal_af_420).
Lucien S healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Lucien S. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Lucien S stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of U-F8, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.

Lucien S felt a hard tug at his hip at U-F8. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Henrik Addicted of the Concord (@addicted_vr).
The wound on Lucien S's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
scottjseale: Gustav Scottjseale took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Gustav Scottjseale added a leak above the man's head in pencil. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Quentin Arvidgrubb and Gustav Scottjseale sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F20. Gustav Scottjseale has learned to walk bent double.

Gustav Scottjseale drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav Scottjseale bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav Scottjseale had just lit a cigarette at R-F20 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Jonas Hill of the Hegemony (@_strawberry.hill_). Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav Scottjseale was hit through the stomach at R-F20. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Zeno Irl of the Hegemony (@king_baldwin_irl). Gustav Scottjseale was killed on watch at R-F20. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Zeno Irl of the Hegemony (@king_baldwin_irl).
Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale took the same post at R-F20 where Gustav Scottjseale stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Gideon "Mud" Cubes was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@sugar_cubes745) Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale was on the dawn watch at R-F20 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale returned to R-F20 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Orders assigned Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale to work as a sapper. The first lesson began with what not to touch. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale answered to number 306. Grey Mill is lost. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale found a muddy Airedale terrier shivering under a duckboard and shared his bread. Now the dog follows him everywhere. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale calls it Scout.

Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale dreamt he was back in Varenne, working as a baker. He woke up and said nothing all morning. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale read a theatre review while peeling supper. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Wiring party. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at R-F20, and everyone came back. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet grazed Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale's ribs at R-F20. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Walter Davebowlton of the Hegemony (@davebowlton). Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Three days with a bandage, and Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale is back at R-F20. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.

Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. The sergeant pretends to hate Scout. Today the sergeant was seen sharing a biscuit with it. The letter for Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale kept them.
tzukitolotl: Lucien Tzukitolotl found a place in S-R1 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-R1 changed before the cheering ended. Lucien Tzukitolotl shouldered another load.

Across from S-R1, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Lucien Tzukitolotl saw it. Clement Ther was grazed. Lucien Tzukitolotl fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Gustav Belugawales, now badly wounded. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Lucien Tzukitolotl during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Lucien Tzukitolotl measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.

A bullet hit Lucien Tzukitolotl in the neck at S-R1. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam of the Concord (@pineapplejamming). A single shot at S-R1. Lucien Tzukitolotl sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam of the Concord (@pineapplejamming).
Yann Tzukitolotl took the same post at S-R1 where Lucien Tzukitolotl stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

The men at S-R1 heard Yann Tzukitolotl call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Pavel Josh of the Concord (@goated.josh). Yann Tzukitolotl was killed on watch at S-R1. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Pavel Josh of the Concord (@goated.josh).
The House of Tzukitolotl sent another. Bastian Tzukitolotl, brother of Yann Tzukitolotl, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Bastian Tzukitolotl left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.

Bastian Tzukitolotl was hit in the foot through his boot at S-R1. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Quentin The of the Concord (@noah_the_0ne). Bastian Tzukitolotl looked over the parapet at S-R1 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Quentin The of the Concord (@noah_the_0ne).
Gideon Tzukitolotl arrived carrying the family name of Bastian Tzukitolotl. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
A dog crosses no man's land at Sorrow Copse every night, fed by Gideon Tzukitolotl on one side and Casimir Freek on the other. The Hegemony call it Patrol. The Concord call it Spy.
welcometomemetown2.0: Day 12: Albin Welcometomem reached U-F1 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Albin Welcometomem had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Nils "Lucky" Nguyen was badly wounded. A letter from home found Albin Welcometomem before the night shift. Albin Welcometomem folded it small and kept it close.

Albin Welcometomem went out with the wiring party at U-F1. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Albin Welcometomem fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Rafael Paraop was gravely wounded. Albin Welcometomem ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home found Albin Welcometomem before the night shift. Albin Welcometomem folded it small and kept it close.
Albin Welcometomem wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.

Albin Welcometomem threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Jonas Pat was down and screaming for a medic. (@bucket_hat_pat_) Albin Welcometomem came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. Albin Welcometomem kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Felix "Lucky" Allu stood up to sing louder, and Albin Welcometomem fired. Felix "Lucky" Allu was grazed. The singing stopped.
zebra.382848: Karel "Saint" Zebra joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Karel "Saint" Zebra changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In P-F4, Karel "Saint" Zebra listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Karel "Saint" Zebra had just lit a cigarette at P-F4 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Walter Stjohn of the Hegemony (@alex_stjohn_).
Three days with a bandage, and Karel "Saint" Zebra is back at P-F4. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Karel "Saint" Zebra went out with the wiring party at P-F4. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
Karel "Saint" Zebra mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Karel "Saint" Zebra kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Karel "Saint" Zebra watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
